channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-ansible
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: Netforge.ai — via awesome-ansible
item.description: Network design tool that turns a topology drawing into a ready-to-run Ansible project: inventory grouped by platform, per-device host_vars, per-platform group_vars and a playbook per platform.

item.title: Ansible Lint GitHub Actions: Fail PRs on Bad Playbooks — via awesome-ansible
item.description: Wires ansible-lint into a pull request check, compares the profiles on a real playbook, and shows how an ignore file can hide new violations.

item.title: ansible-vars — via awesome-ansible
item.description: ansible-vault replacement that supports encrypting individual vault variables.

item.title: speedrunner — via awesome-ansible
item.description: Cuts the start-up time of ansible, ansible-doc and other Ansible commands by serving them from a preloaded daemon, which helps scripts that call them many times.

item.title: Molecule — via awesome-ansible
item.description: Framework for developing and testing Ansible roles.

item.title: OrchidE — via awesome-ansible
item.description: Full-featured Ansible language support for IntelliJ-based IDEs, with code completion, syntax highlighting, inspections, quick documentation, navigation across playbooks, roles and inventories, and integrated Ansible Vault support.
